messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Apology for My Earlier Message  

Hi [Colleague's Name],  

I’m sorry for my abrupt comment earlier; it was unprofessional and I regret any inconvenience it caused. I value our collaboration and will strive to communicate more thoughtfully moving forward.  

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
